Setup / additional actions: Choose a room with working controllable lights that are off. Start a Live conversation. If asked to confirm, say yes. Watch the lights and the HA state.
Expected device result: Requested lights turn on and HA reports on.
Expected Live response: Confirms that the requested lights are on after verification succeeds.
Failure signs: Says device status is unavailable or cannot confirm even though HA reported on within five seconds; claims success for lights that stayed off.

Setup / additional actions: Start with the same lights on. Watch the physical lights and HA state while listening to the reply.
Expected device result: Requested lights turn off and HA reports off.
Expected Live response: Confirms the lights are off without requiring a second question.
Failure signs: Says devices are not reporting status even though HA reports off within five seconds; an immediate follow-up contradicts the first answer.

Setup / additional actions: Choose a lamp already on and reporting on in HA. Compare the tool duration in the activity log with a normal command.
Expected device result: Lamp stays on. Verification returns immediately without a fixed five-second wait.
Expected Live response: Briefly confirms it is on or already on.
Failure signs: Every command waits five seconds despite an immediately matching state; lamp is toggled off and back on.

Setup / additional actions: Use a light, switch, fan, or media player known to update HA a few seconds late. Observe HA and the activity log; do not repeat the request while it is running. Mark Not applicable if no such device is available.
Expected device result: Command is sent once. If HA reaches off within five seconds, polling confirms it at the next one-second check.
Expected Live response: Confirms off after the delayed update, without asking you to check again.
Failure signs: Reports status unavailable before five seconds while the service was accepted; resends the control command; makes a model call for every retry.

Setup / additional actions: Use an existing safely testable lamp that already reports unknown/unavailable in HA. Do not interrupt essential devices. Mark Not applicable if none is available.
Expected device result: An accepted command is checked for up to five seconds; unknown/unavailable is never treated as proof of on or off. A rejected service call is reported as a command error.
Expected Live response: Explains that the final state could not be confirmed, or accurately reports a service-call error. Does not claim the lamp is on.
Failure signs: Claims success despite unavailable state; interprets unavailable as off; repeats the command or keeps checking indefinitely.

Setup / additional actions: After an unconfirmed off command, wait until HA has updated or the device has recovered, then ask this question without giving a new control command.
Expected device result: Reads the current HA state without sending another device command.
Expected Live response: Reports the current off/on state when available; continues to acknowledge uncertainty if it is still unavailable.
Failure signs: Resends turn_off; treats unavailable as off; reports the stale earlier result despite updated HA state.

Setup / additional actions: Choose a dimmable lamp and set it to 35 percent first. Watch HA brightness through any ramp; raw 102 on the 0-255 scale is about 40 percent.
Expected device result: Lamp reaches about 40 percent. After a detected ramp, a matching reading remains stable across successive polls within the five-second window.
Expected Live response: Confirms about 40 percent when verified; otherwise says the final setting was not confirmed yet.
Failure signs: Reports 102 percent; confirms an intermediate brightness; waits beyond the five-second verification window.

Setup / additional actions: Choose a room with multiple lights. First try with all available; if safely practical, repeat when one test lamp is already unavailable. Observe each target.
Expected device result: All available targets turn off. One unavailable or mismatching target cannot make the whole group verified.
Expected Live response: Confirms all off only when all are verified; otherwise identifies that some results remain unconfirmed using friendly names.
Failure signs: One successful light hides another failure; claims every light is off while one is unknown or still on.

Setup / additional actions: Use an available player that supports power control and reports off when shut down. Watch its HA state. Mark Not applicable if your player cannot report power state.
Expected device result: Power-off is sent once and checked for no more than five seconds after service completion.
Expected Live response: Confirms off if HA reports off; says unconfirmed if it only becomes unavailable.
Failure signs: Unavailable is announced as definitely off; shutdown adds the previous longer verification window or repeated controls.

Setup / additional actions: Use an existing safe scene with service actions; if available, choose one with a saved post-condition. Observe targets and the activity log. Do not create a new scene just for this check.
Expected device result: Automatic and explicit post-condition checks share at most five seconds per service action. Explicit scene delays and state-wait steps keep their own timing.
Expected Live response: Reports the scene outcome accurately, including partial or unconfirmed results.
Failure signs: Automatic verification and a post-condition each add another full wait for the same action; later dependent actions run despite a failed required condition.

Setup / additional actions: Open Settings > Apps > Special Agent Live > Log and filter special_agent.activity. Track one request and its control tool start/end records; use a device that needs more than one check.
Expected device result: One control call remains in progress while Python polls. No backend model calls occur between those internal polls.
Expected Live response: Gives the final outcome after the tool result; the normal backend reply and Live speech still take their usual time.
Failure signs: Repeated model sent/received records solely to check the same state; repeated get-state or control calls after the final verification result.

Scenario: Status query has no verification delay
Setup / additional actions: Ask only for current status, without asking to change devices. Watch the activity log if timing is unclear.
Expected device result: Devices stay unchanged; state lookup adds no deliberate one-second or five-second sleep.
Expected Live response: Answers from current state, or explains that state is unavailable.
Failure signs: Status-only request triggers control commands or waits through the command-verification timer.

Setup / additional actions: In a disposable clone, enable .githooks; create a placeholder secrets.yaml, force-stage it, and attempt a commit. Remove the placeholder afterward.
Expected device result: No device action
Expected Live response: Commit is blocked before upload; file contents are not printed
Failure signs: Commit succeeds or private content appears in output

Scenario: Live add-on installs from cleaned history
Setup / additional actions: Build/reinstall the Live add-on from the cleaned branch; use a configured voice device in [room].
Expected device result: Device connects and plays the answer
Expected Live response: A spoken time response; source archive verification succeeds
Failure signs: Archive checksum failure, missing source revision, startup failure, or no spoken answer

Setup / additional actions: Enable Detailed trace logging in the integration and Live app; restart the app. Open its Log and observe HA state and the physical light. Answer confirmation if requested.
Expected device result: Light turns on; existing verification runs once per command.
Expected Live response: Logs connect delegation, agent request, model iterations, tool inputs/results and Live delivery with the same session/job IDs; spoken outcome matches verification.
Failure signs: IDs break at HA handoff; missing arguments/results; false device status unavailable report; success claimed for an unchanged light.

Setup / additional actions: Use a fresh Live session and watch the app Log.
Expected device result: No home device action is expected.
Expected Live response: Live answers conversationally; session route is delegation_only. No home tool execution is attributed directly to Live.
Failure signs: Logs imply Live directly executed HA tools or invent a backend call for conversation handled by Live.

Question to ask: Are the lights on in [room A] and [room B]?
Setup / additional actions: Enable both trace switches. Use two rooms with readable lights. Inspect batch mode and call_id for each selected tool. If the model uses a single lookup, repeat with independent device questions.
Expected device result: Devices do not change.
Expected Live response: Each executed call has matching input, result and model observation; parallel calls share a batch and retain separate call IDs.
Failure signs: Results attached to the wrong call; missing observations; status query changes a device; unsupported spoken success.

Setup / additional actions: Use an already-unavailable safe test device; do not disconnect essential equipment. Enable trace logging and watch its HA state.
Expected device result: No unsupported physical result is assumed; verification stays failed or unverified as appropriate.
Expected Live response: Logs show actual failure or unavailable state and accurate final delivery; Live does not claim confirmed success.
Failure signs: Failure hidden by an ok result; missing terminal event; unsupported success; false status-unavailable claim when HA actually confirms the requested setting.

Question to ask: Run [existing safe scene with a delay].
Setup / additional actions: Use a safe existing scene if available. During its execution ask What is happening? Then stop voice playback. Inspect context wait, model sent/received, tool duration and delivery events.
Expected device result: An action already running follows existing scene behavior; speech interruption alone does not imply device cancellation.
Expected Live response: Logs distinguish pending backend work from completed work and show whether its result was sent, skipped or failed.
Failure signs: Logs claim device action cancellation merely because audio stopped; no final tool result or delivery disposition.

Question to ask: What is the current state of [test device], and what does that tell you?
Setup / additional actions: Enable integration Detailed trace logging. Inspect model_output after the Responses API call. Summaries may be absent depending on model output.
Expected device result: Read-only request leaves the device unchanged.
Expected Live response: Logs show available reasoning_summaries and observable decisions; an empty summary does not masquerade as internal thinking.
Failure signs: Raw/encrypted reasoning dump; session.thinking.append described as a read of Live thoughts; made-up summary.

Setup / additional actions: Compare both switches off, integration only on, then both on. Use harmless placeholders such as api_key=TRACE_TEST_KEY in a test request; never disclose real secrets. Turn tracing off afterward.
Expected device result: Devices remain unchanged.
Expected Live response: Default records contain metadata only. Integration opt-in adds Core payloads; both opt-ins add HA payloads to the Live Log. Recognized credential placeholders are redacted. Disabling clears retained detail replay.
Failure signs: Payloads appear with capture disabled; credentials exposed; multiline payload forges another record; disabling tracing leaves details in the replay endpoint.

Setup / additional actions: With two configured devices, issue separate status requests close together. Enable both detail switches; filter each session/job. Mark Not applicable if only one device is available.
Expected device result: Devices remain unchanged.
Expected Live response: Each response and tool observation stays with its own session/job/request, including any queued wait.
Failure signs: One device inherits the other job ID, request content or spoken result.

Setup / additional actions: Enable both trace switches. Run a request, restart the Live app while HA stays running, then inspect recovered recent records. Confirm runtime and integration include trace support.
Expected device result: No device action is replayed by reconnecting the log stream.
Expected Live response: Recent summaries and bounded redacted details resume; large payloads have explicit truncation markers.
Failure signs: Relay stops on a valid trace record; repeated controls triggered by replay; raw secrets or unbounded log payloads.

Scenario: Install matching integration and Live releases
Setup / additional actions: Update the integration to 0.3.5 or newer and restart HA. Update the Live app to 0.1.7 or newer. Confirm saved agent, device and credential settings remain populated without copying secrets into logs. Enable Detailed trace logging in both places, save and restart the Live app. Check its installed version and startup Log, then ask the status question.
Expected device result: Voice device reconnects and responds; room lights stay unchanged.
Expected Live response: App starts without source-checksum or outdated-runtime errors. Both trace switches are available; the Log connects Live handoff, HA model/tool activity and result delivery. Spoken status agrees with HA state.
Failure signs: Wrong installed version; missing trace switch; lost settings; checksum or runtime-update error; missing spoken response or agent trace; status lookup changes a device.

Setup / additional actions: Install both new releases and enable both trace switches. Open the Live app Log; read the left edge, then scroll right on a tool call and return.
Expected device result: No device changes.
Expected Live response: User message, Live response, Agent tools available, model rounds, tool calls/returns/observations and final response have clear labels. The spoken status agrees with HA.
Failure signs: Logger prefixes hide the action; missing user/Live speech; payload requires reading all IDs first; false status unavailable report.

Question to ask: Are the lights in [room A] on, and find a jazz playlist?
Setup / additional actions: Watch a request where the agent selects multiple independent lookups. If it selects one lookup, repeat with independent device/music queries. Compare each Tool returned timestamp with Agent observation and next model round.
Expected device result: Read-only lookups do not start music or change lights.
Expected Live response: First completed lookup is visible immediately. Agent waiting gives completed/remaining counts; observations and next round follow the entire batch. Live may acknowledge while waiting.
Failure signs: Claims the agent analyzes the first result before the batch finishes; missing slow-tool completion; a read-only query triggers an action.

Setup / additional actions: Start a fresh Voice session. Let Live answer, then briefly speak during a reply and continue. Inspect transcript labels while the session stays open.
Expected device result: No home device action.
Expected Live response: User and Live transcript blocks appear promptly after a short display pause, including no-delegation conversation; repeated words are preserved and blocks are not duplicated.
Failure signs: No transcript until session closes; every token floods logs; speaker text is mixed, duplicated, or claimed to prove physical playback.

Question to ask: What is the state of [unavailable test device]?
Setup / additional actions: Use an already-unavailable safe test device and enable detailed tracing. Inspect any reasoning summary and the failed/unverified result.
Expected device result: No device change or unsupported physical result.
Expected Live response: Logs label supplied reasoning as a summary or explicitly report no summary. Errors and unverified states are clear; spoken outcome matches the evidence.
Failure signs: Invented Agent thought; quiet background context labeled as private thoughts; an error is described as success.

Scenario: Readable details preserve redaction and replay
Setup / additional actions: Compare trace off and on. Use only a harmless api_key=TRACE_TEST_KEY placeholder if testing redaction, including a pause after api_key= before saying the placeholder value. Restart the Live app while HA stays running and inspect recovered records; never use real credentials in a test message.
Expected device result: No device action from log replay.
Expected Live response: Readable labels remain; payloads need both opt-ins in combined logs. Placeholder credentials are redacted on both sides of the separator. Replayed events retain original times and IDs.
Failure signs: Secret copied into readable preview; multiline text forges actions; relay rejects valid formatted events; replay repeats a device command.

Scenario: First wake after a long idle
Setup / additional actions: Install the bridge startup fix. Leave the Voice device unused for at least 10 minutes; say its configured wake word, wait for the chime and speak normally. Open the Live app Log and repeat after another long idle.
Expected device result: The ring stays active through startup; no home device changes.
Expected Live response: First attempt answers the full question. Startup timing and queue diagnostics appear; a normal connection taking over two but under five seconds does not self-abort.
Failure signs: Immediate ring shutdown with startup mic_backlog or mic_stale; missing opening words; needs a second wake; false device status unavailable despite readable HA state.

Scenario: First command keeps its opening words
Setup / additional actions: Choose a safe dimmable lamp, initially at a different brightness. Wait at least 10 minutes between uses, then wake and say the command once after the chime. Watch the lamp, HA state and Live Log; answer confirmation if asked.
Expected device result: The intended lamp reaches about 40 percent once; no unrelated device changes.
Expected Live response: Spoken result agrees with verification and the transcript preserves the complete command.
Failure signs: Beginning of command missing or duplicated; duplicate control calls; unsupported success; false status-unavailable report after verified readback.

Scenario: Follow-ups and a fresh wake after normal timeout
Question to ask: Say hello in one short sentence. Then: Say goodbye in one short sentence.
Setup / additional actions: Ask the first question, then the second while the session is active. Let the configured idle timeout expire and wake again for the first question.
Expected device result: Audio remains clear and the ring returns to idle after the configured quiet interval; no home actions.
Expected Live response: Each utterance receives one reply; the next wake starts with a fresh buffer allowance.
Failure signs: Premature stop after delayed startup; progressively increasing audio delay; old speech replayed into a new session; idle session stays open indefinitely.

Scenario: Cancel while starting and immediately retry
Question to ask: Say hello in one short sentence.
Setup / additional actions: Wake the device and press its center button to cancel while startup is pending. Wake again and ask the question. Use read-only speech for this test.
Expected device result: Cancellation closes capture; the new wake can establish its own session and play a reply.
Expected Live response: No delayed reply or transcript from the canceled attempt enters the new conversation.
Failure signs: Canceled audio reaches the replacement session; late idle message kills the new wake; device remains stuck or needs an app restart.

Scenario: Slow or failed cloud connection remains bounded
Question to ask: Say hello in one short sentence.
Setup / additional actions: Use a spare test setup with controllable cloud delay, or observe an existing outage. Compare a 3-second setup delay, a setup delay over 5 seconds, and a transport stall during an active session. Restore connectivity and wake again; do not disrupt essential home networking.
Expected device result: A moderate startup delay is tolerated. Excessive startup or later stalls close capture instead of retaining an unbounded recording; recovery permits a fresh wake.
Expected Live response: Logs distinguish startup timeout/overflow from active microphone or cloud failures. No home-control success is claimed and no canceled request is replayed.
Failure signs: Immediate abort at the old two-second startup bound; no bounded failure; later stalls inherit a continually growing allowance; old speech executes after recovery.
